cost.network: three repository clones during preparation; the measurement runs offline afterwards

declared_acceptance_before_the_receipt_r.K1: at least twenty real refused states executed, and the split between failures the machine localises into the source and those it does not is reported
declared_acceptance_before_the_receipt_r.K2: for every fix with a new word, it is recorded whether all, some or none of those words are present in the check or the refusal
declared_acceptance_before_the_receipt_r.K3: the location of the real change is compared with the function that refused
declared_acceptance_before_the_receipt_r.K4: the conjunction of the two is counted, and reported as a ceiling rather than as a solve rate
declared_acceptance_before_the_receipt_r.K5: zero model calls and zero parameters

limits: presence in the check or the refusal is necessary, not sufficient: a supplied word still needs a slot, and this round measures only whether the slot is local, not how to choose it
a fix whose new words appear in the test for an unrelated reason counts as supplied; the measurement therefore errs toward optimism, which is the right direction for a ceiling
the refusing function is the innermost function containing the traceback line; a fix may legitimately land in its caller, which this counts as not local
tasks whose historical suites do not run here are recorded and never scored

K1_the_machine_points_into_the_source_on.note: an exception that propagates out of the source leaves a frame there; an assert on a returned value does not, because the code that produced the value has already returned. The split is the finding, so it is reported rather than required

K2_the_word_is_supplied_by_the_check_or_.note: supplied means the identifier is a token of the test that catches the bug or of the machine's own diagnostic lines, or the literal's content appears in their text; the vocabulary is theirs, never invented here

K3_the_slot_is_local_to_the_function_tha.note: computed only over failures the machine localises into the source; for the others no refusing function exists to be local to

K4_the_ceiling_of_parameter_free_repair_.reading: this is the set a slot-search over machine-supplied words could reach without inventing a vocabulary: it is the mechanism's ceiling, not its success rate

why_this_round.the_answer_being_tested: if the word is usually supplied by the check or the refusal and the change usually lands in the function that refused, then parameter-free repair is a small slot search; if not, no slot search is affordable and the bottleneck is somewhere else entirely
why_this_round.the_gap_it_closes: round 23 ended by naming a mechanism -- manufacture speaking checks from the repository's own assertions -- whose two preconditions were never measured
why_this_round.why_it_could_fail: the test may assert only outputs, which do not name the fix's new identifier; the fix may land in a different function from the one that raised
